# vaultwarden_item_secure_note (Ephemeral Resource)

Use this ephemeral resource to read a secure note item by ID, from the personal vault of the provider user or from an organization, without saving its secrets in the Terraform plan or state. Its values can be used in other ephemeral contexts, such as provider configurations and write-only attributes. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

Items in the trash are not found. Items created by Bitwarden clients are supported, with or without an item key; like Bitwarden clients, URIs of an item with an item key are ignored when their checksum does not match.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a secure note without saving it in the plan or state (Terraform 1.10 and later)
ephemeral "vaultwarden_item_secure_note" "certificate" {
  id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "certificate" {
  secret_id                = aws_secretsmanager_secret.certificate.id
  secret_string_wo         = ephemeral.vaultwarden_item_secure_note.certificate.notes
  secret_string_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the item

### Read-Only

- `collection_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the organization collections the item is assigned to
- `favorite` (Boolean) Whether the item is a favorite of the provider user
- `fields` (Attributes List) The custom fields of the item (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `folder_id` (String) ID of the provider user's folder that the item is in
- `name` (String) The name of the item
- `notes` (String, Sensitive) The notes of the item
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that owns the item, `null` for an item in the personal vault of the provider user
- `reprompt` (Boolean) Whether Bitwarden clients ask for the master password before showing the item

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `linked_id` (Number) For a `linked` field, the ID of the item attribute it links to, such as `100` for the username or `101` for the password of a login
- `name` (String) The name of the custom field
- `type` (String) The type of the custom field: `text`, `hidden`, `boolean` or `linked`
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value of the custom field. For a `boolean` field, `true` or `false`. Linked fields have no value
